description: K-MINE is a commercial mining software platform covering the mine lifecycle in modules that share one database: for open pit mines, surveying, geology, pit and dump design, a pit optimiser for ultimate pit limits, slope stability analysis, drill and blast design, infrastructure and production scheduling; for underground mines, surveying, geology, underground design, stope optimisation, ventilation, infrastructure and support. A block model update flows through to design and scheduling without file exports. It is produced by K-MINE, which also offers a Fleet Monitor service for trip verification and consulting on technical reports, mine engineering and digital twins. Coverage is global, with offices listed in North America and the United Kingdom and client quotes from Kazakhstan. It is sold through subscription licensing with updates and technical support, with volume pricing on request, and it imports and exports standard formats such as DXF, CSV, LAS, STR, DM, DAT, DTM and 3DS. Caveats: the page is marketing material and gives no prices or technical documentation. For simulation it provides mine design, stability and scheduling models on which studies of mine production disruption, slope hazards and ventilation can be built. It is related to the Deswik and Datamine records in this catalogue, other mine planning suites.
